name: Abrade
description: Entry-level salvage beam that strips hull material at a modest rate. Fits most salvage ships.
effect: Entry-level salvage beam. 50m range. Strips hull material at 0.5 SCU/min. Fits most salvage ships.

name: Cinch
description: Basic salvage beam with a compact size suitable for smaller vessels. Lower throughput but easy to fit.
effect: Basic salvage beam. 40m range. Strips hull at 0.3 SCU/min. Compact size for smaller vessels.

name: Snack
description: Improved salvage beam with better efficiency and range than entry-level heads.
effect: Improved salvage beam. 60m range. Strips hull at 0.8 SCU/min. Better efficiency than entry-level heads.

name: Salvage Filler
description: Fills space with low-quality filler material to fix the 'fracture' state on a hull.
effect: Fills 0.5 SCU of space with low-quality filler material. Used to fix the 'fracture' state.

name: Salvage Caulk
description: Temporarily repairs hull fractures for 1 minute, stopping debris shedding.
effect: Temporarily repairs hull fractures. 1-minute duration. Stops debris shedding.

name: Salvage Stabilizer
description: Prevents hull fracture during high-speed salvage operations for 5 minutes.
effect: Prevents hull fracture during high-speed salvage operations. 5-minute duration.

name: RMC (Recycled Material Composite)
description: High-quality salvaged hull material used in ship manufacturing and repair. 1 SCU per crate.
effect: High-quality salvaged hull material. Used in ship manufacturing and repair. 1 SCU per crate.

name: Construction Waste
description: Low-value debris from damaged ship hulls. Bulk material with minimal refining value.
effect: Low-value debris from damaged ship hulls. Bulk material with minimal refining value.

name: Salvaged Goods
description: Recovered cargo and equipment from derelict ships. Value varies based on original contents.
effect: Recovered cargo and equipment from derelict ships. Variable value based on original contents.
